pob.text: Suppose a man carries holy meat in the fold of his garment[a], and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food—does it become holy? And the priests answered and said[b], “No.”

spob.text: Suppose a man is carrying holy meat in a fold of his garment. If that fold then touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any other food, does the food become holy? The priests answered, “No.”

pob.text: Then Haggai said[a], “If one who is unclean by contact with a dead body touches any of these, does it become unclean?” And the priests answered and said, “It becomes unclean.”

spob.text: Then Haggai asked, “If someone who became ritually unclean by touching a dead body touches any of these things, does the thing touched also become ritually unclean?” The priests answered, “Yes, it becomes ritually unclean.”

public_domain_references.bsb: So Haggai asked, “If one who is defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these, does it become defiled?” “Yes, it becomes defiled,” the priests answered.

pob.text: Then Haggai answered and said[a], “So is this people, and so is this nation before me,” declares Yahweh, “and so is every work of their hands[b]; and what they offer there is unclean.”

pob.text: And now[a], please set your heart on this from today onward: before one stone was placed upon another in the temple of Yahweh,

pob.text: When one came to a heap of twenty measures[a], there were only ten; when one came to the wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.
